overview.heading: Policy Overview
overview.text: BAUST maintains a standard dress code to foster discipline, professionalism, and a sense of unity among students. All students are required to adhere to the prescribed uniform and grooming standards while on campus.

important_note.heading: Important Note
important_note.text: Students found violating the dress code may be denied entry to classes or campus premises. Please refer to the full PDF guide for detailed specifications on fabric, color, and design.

guide_document.heading: Official Specification Guide
guide_document.subheading: Visual specifications for male and female uniforms.
